item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-4ab1d259311b7a35","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The MDS Monitora dashboard is an official public monitoring tool intended to track ministry deliveries, agreed PEI and PPA targets, and program-specific indicators, with alternative geographic and temporal disaggregation available through Vis Data.","question_ids":["6B.5","8B.1","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The dashboard describes the 2023-2026 planning period but the supplied extract does not provide completed 2023 outcome values.","ruler_attribution":"The dashboard concerns federal MDS programs during Lula's 2023-2026 administration, but the extract does not establish Lula's personal role in each operational measure.","limitations":["Most displayed values are loading or refer to 2026 rather than 2023.","This is evidence of monitoring architecture and planned targets, not verified delivery outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4ab1d259311b7a35","start_unit":2,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The dashboard sets quantified Bolsa Família monitoring targets for education and health conditionality coverage, including 85% for beneficiaries aged 6-15, 75% for ages 16-17, 72% for ages 4-5, 65% for health follow-up of children aged 0-7, and 82% for women and children.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Targets are framed for 2023-2026 or through 2027, so they establish planned priorities rather than 2023 achievements.","ruler_attribution":"The targets are official MDS/PPA objectives under the federal administration; the extract does not show Lula personally selecting or implementing each target.","limitations":["No actual 2023 coverage results are supplied.","Several indicators and execution fields are marked Loading."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4ab1d259311b7a35","start_unit":11,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"The dashboard specifies assistance and BPC targets covering electronic SUAS records, Cadastro Único and CRAS coverage, CREAS and Centro Pop availability, child protection, updated BPC records, and maximum average BPC processing times of 45 days for older people and 90 days for people with disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The targets are dated 2023-2026 or through 2027; they show planned institutional objectives, not verified 2023 implementation.","ruler_attribution":"These are official federal social-assistance targets during Lula's administration, without evidence in the extract of Lula's individual operational decisions.","limitations":["No completed 2023 results are shown.","The extract does not establish whether the targets were funded, staffed, or achieved."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4ab1d259311b7a35","start_unit":22,"end_unit":27,"fact_summary":"The dashboard sets food-security and water-access objectives, including municipal SISAN expansion, food donations and baskets, and delivery of 208,000 household or school water technologies, 12,000 production-water technologies, and 3,000 drinking-water technologies for Indigenous populations by 2026.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"These are 2023-2026 or 2027 targets and do not demonstrate completed 2023 outputs.","ruler_attribution":"The objectives are official federal program commitments of Lula's administration; individual presidential authorship is not shown.","limitations":["No verified 2023 delivery totals are supplied.","Many execution fields are marked Loading."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4ab1d259311b7a35","start_unit":30,"end_unit":37,"fact_summary":"The dashboard establishes PAA and Fomento Rural inclusion targets, including at least 60% Cadastro Único families and 60% women among PAA suppliers, additional targets for Indigenous, quilombola, traditional, young, and agrarian-reform farmers, and service targets for 89,810 or 131,000 rural families.","question_ids":["6B.3","6B.8","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The targets cover 2023-2027 and are not accompanied by verified 2023 outcomes in the extract.","ruler_attribution":"These are official federal program targets during Lula's administration, but the source does not establish personal presidential direction.","limitations":["No actual participation or beneficiary results are shown.","The dashboard contains incomplete/loading data."]},{"source_id":"SRC-eb11fbdeb47e8d54","start_unit":1,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The 2023 federal budget legislation recorded multiple extraordinary, special, and supplementary credits, including R$71.44 billion for Bolsa Família, R$7.3 billion for health, R$640 million and R$24 million for emergency credits involving MDS and other ministries, and further credits for health, education, infrastructure, agriculture, defense, and social programs.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","6B.1","6B.2","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"These are enacted 2023 budget measures.","ruler_attribution":"The credits were enacted through federal executive and legislative budget processes during Lula's presidency; the page does not isolate Lula's personal choice from cabinet, Congress, or statutory procedures.","limitations":["The page lists authorizations, not actual execution or service outcomes.","The extract does not establish distributional incidence or whether all credits were spent."]},{"source_id":"SRC-eb11fbdeb47e8d54","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Decree 11.847 of 22 December 2023 expanded the federal budget by R$6 billion for a fund intended to finance and manage savings incentives for secondary-school students' continued attendance and completion.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","6B.2","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"This was enacted in December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The measure was issued during Lula's administration, but the extract does not identify the President's personal role beyond the federal executive context.","limitations":["The source establishes budget authorization, not implementation or educational outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-eb11fbdeb47e8d54","start_unit":19,"end_unit":19,"fact_summary":"Portaria SOF/MPO nº262 of 20 September 2023 reduced portions of extraordinary-credit appropriations opened by MP 1.168 after that measure lost legal effectiveness.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"This occurred during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The adjustment was an official budget-management response within Lula's administration; the source does not establish personal presidential direction.","limitations":["The extract does not explain the underlying policy failure or the amount ultimately spent."]},{"source_id":"SRC-eb11fbdeb47e8d54","start_unit":21,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"The 2023 budget framework included a presidentially issued programming-and-finance decree, subsequent amendments to monthly disbursement schedules, spending-limit adjustments, and procedures for budget changes, emendas, and authorization of expenditures.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"These measures governed 2023 budget execution.","ruler_attribution":"The framework reflects formal executive and legislative budget institutions during Lula's administration, not solely Lula's personal decisions.","limitations":["The extract does not provide execution rates, audit findings, or evidence of corrective performance."]},{"source_id":"SRC-417b548172f1809a","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Lula's presidency was listed as the author of PLP 93/2023, which became Complementary Law 200 on 30 August 2023 and instituted a sustainable fiscal regime intended to support macroeconomic stability and socioeconomic growth; it was sanctioned with a partial veto.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","8B.1","8B.2","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The proposal and enactment occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Senate record expressly attributes authorship to the Presidency of the Republic, while enactment involved bicameral legislative approval.","limitations":["The extract does not show subsequent fiscal outcomes or whether the regime achieved its stated goals.","Authorship by the Presidency does not establish Lula's personal drafting or negotiation role."]},{"source_id":"SRC-417b548172f1809a","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The Senate Economic Affairs Committee approved the fiscal-framework report by 19 votes to 6 with no abstentions, after considering a public hearing and numerous amendments.","question_ids":["4B.4","5B.3","6B.5","8B.5"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The committee action occurred on 21 June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"This records legislative scrutiny and coalition passage during Lula's presidency, not a personal act by Lula.","limitations":["The extract does not show the content of every amendment or the quality of subsequent implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-417b548172f1809a","start_unit":88,"end_unit":89,"fact_summary":"On 21 June 2023 the Senate approved PLP 93 and specified amendments by 57 votes to 17, rejected highlighted amendments 83, 89, and 101, and approved the final wording before returning the measure to the Chamber.","question_ids":["4B.4","5B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The vote occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The result demonstrates use of formal legislative procedures during Lula's administration; it does not establish Lula's personal control over the vote.","limitations":["The record does not show the Chamber's complete subsequent deliberation in the supplied units.","No economic outcomes are reported."]},{"source_id":"SRC-417b548172f1809a","start_unit":113,"end_unit":115,"fact_summary":"The measure was sanctioned as Complementary Law 200 on 30 August 2023 with a partial veto, and the Senate record states that the fiscal regime was intended to secure macroeconomic stability, control public debt, and create conditions for growth.","question_ids":["5B.3","8B.2","8B.6","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Sanction occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The law was sanctioned by the Presidency after legislative approval; the source does not attribute later operation or outcomes directly to Lula.","limitations":["The extract states objectives and enactment, not results.","The record notes later veto-related proceedings outside the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-58e604f340791587","start_unit":12,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"The April 2023 reported version of PL 2630 removed a proposed regulatory agency, retained provisions for platform transparency and user appeal, and gained government support after the 8 January attacks and school attacks.","question_ids":["3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The reported legislative proposal and government support occurred in April 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The article attributes increased government support to Lula's government but describes a congressional relator's text rather than a completed presidential act.","limitations":["The proposal was not shown here as enacted law.","The source is a newspaper report reproducing a legislative text, not an independent implementation evaluation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-58e604f340791587","start_unit":17,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"The proposed internet framework required platforms to assess systemic risks, publish risk reports, mitigate risks with human oversight, provide user notification and review channels, publish transparency reports, conduct annual independent audits, and provide researchers access to anonymized data.","question_ids":["1B.9","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","6B.5","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"These were proposed provisions under debate in 2023, not demonstrated 2023 implementation.","ruler_attribution":"The text was presented by congressional relator Orlando Silva and associated with the government-backed legislative effort; it does not establish Lula's personal authorship.","limitations":["The proposal's safeguards and obligations were not shown as enacted or enforced.","The source includes extensive expert disagreement about privacy, encryption, and regulatory overreach."]},{"source_id":"SRC-58e604f340791587","start_unit":19,"end_unit":20,"fact_summary":"The proposed text included public-administration advertising transparency, media-literacy and digital-safety education, child privacy protections, limits on mass forwarding, judicially constrained preservation of identifying information, sanctions, a criminal offense for coordinated mass dissemination of knowingly false criminally sanctionable facts, and CGI.br oversight.","question_ids":["1B.9","3B.3","3B.7","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","6B.2","6B.8","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"These provisions were proposed in 2023 and were not shown as implemented during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The provisions came from the congressional substitute associated with the government's legislative push, not from a demonstrated personal presidential order.","limitations":["No enactment or enforcement evidence appears in the supplied extract.","The text combines protective safeguards with potentially coercive sanctions and data-retention powers."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Justice told the 8 January CPMI that Federal National Force deployment was constrained by an STF ruling requiring state consent absent federal intervention; it stated that a 7 January arrangement assigned the Force to the Justice Palace and Federal Police headquarters, and that DF consent for deployment arrived at 17:29 on 8 January.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.4","2B.6","2B.9","3B.9","4B.4","8B.9"],"polarity":"exculpatory","period_fit":"The underlying decisions concern 7-8 January 2023; the explanation was presented on 31 August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was made by Justice Minister Flávio Dino's ministry; it describes legal and intergovernmental constraints rather than Lula's personal decision.","limitations":["This is the ministry's account presented to a contested parliamentary inquiry.","The extract does not independently resolve whether the legal interpretation or operational response was correct."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Justice stated that its camera contract required only 30 days of storage and that, by 30 August, it had preserved and sent to the CPMI only images deemed important by competent authorities for investigations.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.9","3B.4","4B.6","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The contract and preservation practice relate to the January 2023 events; the explanation was supplied in August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statement concerns Ministry of Justice administrative practice under Lula's government, without evidence of Lula's personal direction.","limitations":["The account is contested by opposition members in the same hearing.","It does not establish whether preservation duties were legally satisfied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":20,"end_unit":22,"fact_summary":"GSI chief Marco Gonçalves Dias testified that he activated the Plan Escudo on 5-6 January, received divergent intelligence and operational information on 8 January, went personally to the Planalto, called Lula and the Military Commander of the Planalto, and requested additional troops; two companies arrived at 16:40 and 17:15.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.9","3B.2","3B.9","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"These actions occurred on 5-8 January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony attributes the troop request to Gonçalves Dias and states that he called Lula; it does not establish a separate presidential operational order.","limitations":["The testimony is self-exculpatory and contested by other CPMI participants.","The extract contains conflicting accounts about when and whether the plan was fully activated."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":22,"end_unit":22,"fact_summary":"Gonçalves Dias testified that the Planalto evacuation was conducted from the upper floors downward, that force was employed incrementally to avoid deaths and serious injuries, and that 182 invaders were arrested at the palace under his orders.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.9","3B.2","3B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The arrests and evacuation occurred on 8 January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony attributes the operational orders to the GSI chief, not directly to Lula.","limitations":["This is the witness's own account during a contested inquiry.","It does not establish whether earlier preventive measures were adequate."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":21,"end_unit":21,"fact_summary":"Gonçalves Dias testified that no official Sisbin intelligence report was transmitted through the formal Correio Sisbin channel from 2 to 8 January and that he exchanged sensitive security information through personal WhatsApp contacts; he said he learned only after 8 January that intelligence agencies had another WhatsApp group.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.7","1B.8","3B.2","8B.5"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The communication failures occurred during 2-8 January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony concerns GSI and intelligence-system procedures during Lula's first week in office; it does not establish that Lula designed or knew of the communication failure.","limitations":["The account is testimony, not an independent audit finding.","Other hearing participants disputed the completeness and handling of the alerts."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":34,"end_unit":36,"fact_summary":"Gonçalves Dias testified that the established integrated protocol and crisis center were not activated on 8 January, that no operational plan was produced by the DF Military Police for that date, and that the first-line police barriers and searches were absent or ineffective.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.9","3B.2","3B.9","8B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The failures occurred on 8 January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony places primary responsibility for the integrated protocol and first-line police deployment with DF security authorities, while the GSI remained part of the broader security plan.","limitations":["This is a contested witness account.","It does not by itself resolve federal versus district responsibility."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":48,"end_unit":49,"fact_summary":"Gonçalves Dias testified that he initially changed about nine GSI personnel and, between 8 January and 19 April, changed roughly 250 personnel; he acknowledged that retaining the inherited executive secretary and other personnel may have been an error and said he ordered a formal inquiry into failures.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.4","4B.5","7B.5","7B.6","8B.4","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The appointments and changes occurred during January-April 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The personnel decisions were made by the GSI chief appointed by Lula; the extract does not establish direct presidential involvement in those appointments.","limitations":["The witness's account is contested and does not establish the political views or culpability of every retained official.","The inquiry's final findings are not supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":51,"end_unit":55,"fact_summary":"During questioning, Gonçalves Dias confirmed receiving alerts from Saulo about intended violent actions and possible invasions, but disputed the number of alerts personally received and said the Plan Escudo was activated; he also testified that troop reinforcements arrived after he contacted General Dutra around 14:40.","question_ids":["1B.8","2B.4","2B.9","3B.2","3B.9","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The alerts and troop requests concern 6-8 January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony concerns the appointed GSI chief's actions and communications; it does not establish Lula's operational direction.","limitations":["The hearing records conflicting timestamps and accounts from Gonçalves Dias, General Dutra, and opposition members.","The witness did not answer every question under the terms of his habeas corpus."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":67,"end_unit":67,"fact_summary":"Opposition members alleged that the GSI chief received 33 intelligence alerts, including warnings on 6 and 8 January about armed participants and intended invasions, and argued that insufficient forces were deployed; these allegations were presented as evidence of possible omission.","question_ids":["1B.8","2B.4","2B.9","3B.2","3B.9","7B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The alleged alerts and deployment decisions concern 6-8 January 2023; the allegations were made on 31 August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The allegations concern Gonçalves Dias and federal security management, not a demonstrated personal act by Lula.","limitations":["These are adversarial statements by CPMI members, not final institutional findings.","The hearing also records the witness's contrary account that the plan was activated and that he sought reinforcements."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":83,"end_unit":85,"fact_summary":"The hearing recorded that the DF integrated operations center's images were reportedly deleted after 60 days under the responsible authority's storage practice, while opposition members alleged that Ministry of Justice image preservation was incomplete.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.9","3B.4","4B.6","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The deletion and preservation issues relate to January 2023 evidence and were discussed in August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statements concern DF and federal administrative bodies; the supplied extract does not establish Lula's personal direction.","limitations":["The claims are contested and lack a final judicial or audit finding in the supplied units.","The record does not establish whether deletion violated a preservation order at the time."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":108,"end_unit":109,"fact_summary":"Gonçalves Dias acknowledged that retaining General Penteado and the inherited structure was an error in retrospect, while declining to conclude that his administration had been sabotaged.","question_ids":["3B.2","4B.5","7B.5","8B.4","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The acknowledgment concerns personnel decisions made in the first days of 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statement concerns the GSI chief's own management judgment under Lula's government.","limitations":["It is a retrospective self-assessment, not an independent personnel review."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":109,"end_unit":112,"fact_summary":"Gonçalves Dias testified that he personally ordered a GSI inquiry, received no instruction to cover up evidence, preserved the presidential office area, and requested Army reinforcement; he also stated that some entrants entered to look around while most sought to vandalize or reach the President's office.","question_ids":["2B.9","3B.4","3B.9","7B.6","7B.7","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The inquiry order and operational actions occurred in January 2023 and were described in August 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony attributes the inquiry and operational decisions to the GSI chief; it also states Lula was informed and was his superior.","limitations":["The testimony is self-exculpatory and does not supply the inquiry's final findings.","It does not establish that all responsible actors were disciplined."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":126,"end_unit":128,"fact_summary":"A government-aligned senator argued that the GSI had about 1,200 personnel and that eight days were insufficient to map politically motivated infiltrators; the witness confirmed the approximate staffing level and denied acting with intent or culpable negligence.","question_ids":["3B.2","4B.5","7B.5","8B.4"],"polarity":"exculpatory","period_fit":"The staffing and transition context concerns the first eight days of 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The staffing fact concerns the GSI under Lula; the exculpatory legal characterization was a senator's argument rather than an adjudicated finding.","limitations":["No independent assessment of the feasibility of screening personnel is supplied.","The extract does not establish the actual number or role of politically aligned staff."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":150,"end_unit":152,"fact_summary":"Gonçalves Dias confirmed that most senior GSI personnel remained from General Heleno's prior administration, that only nine people were initially removed, and that the GSI was not invited to the 6 January DF security meeting; the hearing also recorded that an inherited official released a troop from readiness.","question_ids":["3B.2","4B.5","7B.5","8B.4","8B.5"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"These transition and readiness decisions concern January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The staffing was under the GSI chief appointed by Lula, while the inherited officials came from the prior administration; the source does not establish Lula's direct role in retaining them.","limitations":["The troop-release allegation was presented by a senator and was not independently resolved in the extract.","The record does not establish whether retention was legally or operationally improper."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4cfc54337ead57ed","start_unit":155,"end_unit":158,"fact_summary":"The witness stated that the Plan Escudo was activated on 6 January, requested one ready platoon and two platoons on standby, and that 135 personnel were present when the barrier broke; he disputed receiving all 33 Abin alerts and said he personally received 11 direct alerts.","question_ids":["2B.4","3B.2","3B.9","8B.3","8B.5","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The plan, force posture, and alerts concern 6-8 January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony concerns the GSI chief's operational decisions; it does not establish presidential operational control.","limitations":["The hearing contains contradictory official and political accounts about activation and reinforcement.","The witness's numbers differ from figures asserted by other participants."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-58e604f340791587"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied sources largely concern planned policies, legislative proposals, budget authorizations, and contested parliamentary testimony rather than verified 2023 outcome data.","The Monitora MDS extract is dominated by loading fields and later-year indicators, limiting direct inference about 2023 implementation.","The CPMI transcript contains partisan assertions and conflicting testimony; allegations are preserved as allegations rather than treated as established findings.","No material facts were identified for nuclear risk, international war, corruption, or personal financial integrity beyond the specific institutional and accountability matters recorded above."]}
